generator_cmd: python3 -I mk_oci.py edge_oci.tar  (stdlib tarfile writer: OCI image layout, no manifest.json; arm64/v8, Entrypoint [/usr/bin/edge-agent], Cmd null)
oracle_cmd: tar -xOf edge_oci.tar blobs/sha256/$(tar -xOf edge_oci.tar blobs/sha256/$(tar -xOf edge_oci.tar index.json | jq -r '.manifests[0].digest|sub("sha256:";"")') | jq -r '.config.digest|sub("sha256:";"")') | jq -c .config.Cmd | sed 's/^null$/none/'
